Slots: {order} {total} {product} {po} {supplier} {days} {campaign} {name} {first} {rating} {month} {profit} {amount} {count} {date}. Staff write like themselves: Fezziwig warm and generous, Scrooge counts every penny, Cratchit meek and careful, Fogg exact about time, Mole shy and homely, Hudson firm and kind, Weller cheerful with odd comparisons, Summerson modest, Crusoe keeps lists, Toad over-excited, Hephaestus terse. No emoji, no exclamation marks except Toad and Weller and Fezziwig, who earn them.
